content.text:
## 1. Page structure (hybrid template)

Shared template: `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\components\services\service-page-template.tsx`  
Routed via `src\app\(marketing)\[slug]\page.tsx`.

**Fixed sections (all text/card UI):** Hero (copy + lead form) → stats → problem → audience → solution → deliverables → differ → **modules** → results → FAQ → related services → CTA.

**Hybrid modules:** optional `service.modules[]` (max 4), rendered by `src\components\services\modules\service-modules.tsx` (+ shell). Schema: `src\domain\content\schemas\service-page.schema.ts`. Content: `content\config\services\{slug}.json`.

| Module | Visual nature |
|--------|----------------|
| `browserProof` | Raster images in browser chrome |
| `proofGallery` | Raster gallery |
| `metricChart` | CSS bar chart (numbers in JSON) |
| `comparisonTable` / `processSteps` / `checklistMatrix` | Structured text UI only |

---

## 2–5. Inventory (15 root services)

Hero has **no service imagery** (partner badge only from site config). Images live under `modules[].images[].src` or `modules[].items[].src`.

| slug | modules present | static-heavy sections | image assets used |
|------|-----------------|----------------------|-------------------|
| `full-service-amazon-agency` | browserProof, comparisonTable, checklistMatrix | problem–differ, results, FAQ | `/images/growth/sales-brand-yoy.avif`, `sales-dashboard-2yr.avif` |
| `amazon-ppc-management-agency` | browserProof, metricChart, comparisonTable | problem–differ, results, FAQ | `sales-primeday.avif`, `sales-803k.avif` |
| `amazon-listing-optimization` | proofGallery, processSteps, checklistMatrix | problem–differ, results, FAQ | creative-before-after / infographic / aplus `-v2.png` |
| `amazon-content-writing` | proofGallery, checklistMatrix, comparisonTable | problem–differ, results, FAQ | `/images/services/content-writing-v2.png`, `listing-seo-v2.png`, `creative-aplus-v2.png` |
| `amazon-visual-creativity` | proofGallery, processSteps, checklistMatrix | problem–differ, results, FAQ | 5× `/images/creative/*-v2.png` |
| `amazon-catalog-management` | checklistMatrix, comparisonTable, processSteps | **all mid-page text-only** (no raster) | none |
| `amazon-dsp-management` | browserProof, comparisonTable, checklistMatrix | problem–differ, results, FAQ | `sales-primeday.avif`, `sales-brand-yoy.avif` |
| `amazon-reporting-analytics` | browserProof, metricChart, checklistMatrix | problem–differ, results, FAQ | `sales-dashboard-2yr.avif`, `sales-90day.avif` |
| `amazon-video-creative` | proofGallery, processSteps, checklistMatrix | problem–differ, results, FAQ | hero-product, lifestyle, aplus `-v2.png` |
| `amazon-trademark-brand-registry` | processSteps, checklistMatrix, comparisonTable | **all mid-page text-only** | none |
| `amazon-company-registration` | processSteps, checklistMatrix, comparisonTable | **all mid-page text-only** | none |
| `amazon-product-sourcing` | processSteps, checklistMatrix, comparisonTable | **all mid-page text-only** | none |
| `shopify-website-development` | processSteps, checklistMatrix, comparisonTable | **all mid-page text-only** | none |
| `tiktok-shop-ads` | proofGallery, processSteps, comparisonTable | problem–differ, results, FAQ | 4× creative `-v2.png` (shared pool) |
| `email-retention-marketing` | processSteps, checklistMatrix, comparisonTable | **all mid-page text-only** | none |

---

## Visual / infographic gaps (medium take)

- **9/15** have raster modules (`browserProof` or `proofGallery`).
- **6/15** are structural-only (table/steps/checklist): catalog, trademark, company registration, product sourcing, Shopify, email.
- **`metricChart`** only on PPC + reporting (2 pages).
- **No hero/product/infographic per service** outside modules; creative pages reuse the same `/images/creative/*` set; growth pages reuse `/images/growth/*.avif`.
- JSON image paths: `modules[n].images[].src` (`browserProof`) or `modules[n].items[].src` (`proofGallery`).
